reviewPolicy: Count a refusal on an answerable question as incorrect.
Judge semantic correctness rather than exact wording or formatting.
Require cited text to support the requested entity, relation, period, and answer.
Record an evaluation-scope issue when a question uses an unresolved document/page/case reference while documentIds are omitted.
